That's How I Turbined My IA's

The video summarizes Gio Mangoni's tips to configure AI tools beyond the text box: personal instructions, memory, connectors with other applications and isolated projects. It shows that the same logic applies to Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and Qwen, and ends with a practical challenge.

Published in September 25, 2026 · 7 min 9 s

  • AI tools

Open on YouTube

The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets lead to the stretch of the video.

In this article

  1. The settings that hardly anyone uses
  2. Hidden prompts
  3. Personal instructions and memory
  4. Connectors with other applications
  5. Isolated projects
  6. The Challenge
  7. Frequently Asked Questions

The settings that hardly anyone uses

A lot of people use AI tools every day without knowing there's a layer of settings behind 00:00. The difference appears in the Gemini example: without configuration, it does not know who you are; configured, responds already knowing your context 00:20.

The video summarizes the tips of Gio Mangoni, who, according to the video, created the method after 250 consulting in AI 00:41. She realized that most professionals don't know you can set up the AI at this level. 01:04.

Hidden prompts

The AI not only reads what you type, but also a series of invisible prompts 01:45. Video compares to a restaurant: what you type is the request to the waiter; hidden prompts are the cooking rules 01:45.

Personal instructions and memory

The first step is to configure personal instructions: your context, for example AI consultant, and rules such as advanced "level, without emojis" 02:05. So you don't have to repeat that to every conversation. 02:26.

Memory keeps context over time and improves the next responses 02:48. But she needs care. 02:48:

  • enable or disable memory resources 03:09;
  • update the facts saved, for example when an old strategy ceases to count 03:09;
  • Delete old conversations because old data generate bad answers with a lot of confidence 03:09.

Connectors with other applications

The connectors pull the AI out of the bubble. On Gemini, you can connect Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive and Calendar) and YouTube 03:29. On other platforms, you can connect Notion, Slack, Canva and HubSpot 03:51.

With this, you consult live data. For example: "Resume last month's services from my calendar" instead of opening five tabs and copying and pasting 03:51.

Isolated projects

Projects, also called notebooks, are isolated environments for specific tasks, such as a budget assistant with its own financial rules 04:31. Being isolated, AI does not mix the rules of a cost spreadsheet with a brainstorming from another chat 04:53.

To build a project 04:53:

  • set name and description 04:53;
  • write the instructions for that environment 04:53;
  • consolidate a chat history 04:53;
  • send context files or links such as a tag manual or transcript of a meeting 05:14.

Logic applies to various tools: Gemini speaks in notebooks and extensions; ChatGPT, Claude and Qwen talk in projects, connectors or plugins 05:36.

The Challenge

The challenge is to send the transcript that gave rise to the video for a new project and ask AI for use cases and instructions for a real workflow 05:56. To view each menu on screen, the video recommends the original channel of Gio Mangoni on YouTube 06:16.

Frequently Asked Questions

Why delete old conversations?

Because AI uses memory to respond, and outdated data generates bad answers with a lot of confidence 03:09.

Does this work on any AI tool?

Logic works on Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and Qwen. Only change the name of the menu 05:36.

Reviewed by Maurício Yokoyama Issei in 16 November 2026.

About the video

Do you want much more relevant and personalized answers from your artificial intelligence tools? In this video, you will learn how to configure the so-called hidden prompts**, simple and powerful features present on the main platforms of the market to turn AI into a highly contextualized wizard.

Learn to apply**permanent instructions**, manage the **A memory**, activate **app connectors** and structure **dedicated projects and folders** so you never need to reexplain your work context from scratch.

---

**What you will learn in this video:**
* **Permanent Instructions and Customization:** How to inform your professional context and define exactly the response style you prefer.
* ** Memory Management:** Understand how AI saves facts about you over time and how to view, edit or clear that memory.
* **App Connectors:** Connect your AI to Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar), Slack, Canva and other tools for direct queries and automations.
* ** Organizational Projects and Environments:** Create folders/notebooks with documents and guidelines suitable for specific projects.
* **Multiple Tool Demonstration:**Practical Guide in **Gemini**, **ChatGPT**, **Claude**, **Qwen**, **Perplexity**, **Manus** and **Grok**.
